info.title: C48 Identity API
info.description: Identity authentication, administration, and service-to-service endpoints. Browser writes require an allowed Origin and the CSRF header; Native requests use bearer/JSON tokens and must not send cookies or Origin. Internal endpoints are blocked by the public Nginx route.

get.summary: Issue browser pre-session and CSRF cookies

200.description: CSRF token; Set-Cookie issues c48_pre (HttpOnly) and c48_csrf (readable), both Secure, SameSite=Strict, host-only, Path=/api/v1 for Web state changes across services.

post.description: Creates only a CITIZEN/SYSTEM grant. Browser transport requires Cookie, allowed Origin and X-CSRF-Token; Native transport sends no cookies or Origin. Idempotency replays return the same user response.

post.summary: Create a Web or Native session
post.description: WEB requires allowed Origin, pre-session cookies and X-CSRF-Token, returns HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookies (c48_access, c48_pre and c48_csrf Path=/api/v1; c48_refresh Path=/api/v1/identity/auth), and rotates CSRF. NATIVE requires no cookies or Origin and returns tokens in JSON without Set-Cookie.

post.summary: Resolve user display names for service-owned records
post.description: Restricted to Response and Logistics service tokens. Callers must derive IDs from records they own and enforce that ownership before calling; Identity cannot verify relationships held only in another service database. Each caller integration must test this boundary. Batches contain at most 100 IDs, unknown Identity users are omitted, lookup logs the count only, and responses include Cache-Control: no-store.
